comment: Registry attributes are classified as stable and catalogue attributes as dynamic. Regulatory status, packaging, manufacturer, and product authorisation can change materially, while some formulary or clinical attributes may remain stable for long periods.

citation.raw: §Product Registry comparison p.152 l.“Data stability” row

public.text: Registry attributes are classified as stable and catalogue attributes as dynamic. Regulatory status, packaging, manufacturer, and product authorisation can change materially, while some formulary or clinical attributes may remain stable for long periods.
public.suggestedRevision: Use relative update frequency and governance authority rather than a stable-versus-dynamic binary distinction.
